newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler January int'l sales off 2 percent.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler January int'l sales off 2 percent.

text.p: Chrysler International, a unit of Chrysler Corp, said Wednesday that retail sales of vehicles outside North America were slightly lower in January 1997 compared with last year.
Chrysler reported total sales of 17,366 vehicles, about two percent lower than the 17,641 in January 1996.

Jeep products posted the highest percentage sales increases in January, with Grand Cherokee sales up 44 percent and Wrangler up 28 percent, the company said. Chrysler minivans sold outside North America totaled 4,377, up 21 percent.
